newsitem.title: USA: CNA Financial files $1 bln shelf.
newsitem.headline: CNA Financial files $1 bln shelf.

text.p: CNA Financial Corp filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday to sell up to $1 billion in debt securities and preferred stock.
When combined with a previous registration, CNA will have a total offering of $1,250,000,000 in securities and stock available for sale.
Net proceeds will be used to pay down borrowings outstanding under CNA's revolving credit facility and/or commercial paper program, the company said in the filing.

The remaining proceeds will be added to the company's general funds and used for general corporate purposes, which may include, but are not limited to, prepayment of other debt, and capital contributions to CNA's subsidiaries.
CNA, based in Chicago, is in the property and casualty insurance business.
